items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Her favorite music is Latin music. She told me.

ctx.x: She seems soft to me. She doesn't like to play New Orleans music? No.

She wants to play modern stuff. She plays with her son. She has a band with her son, so they play more modern jazz. Her favorite music is Latin music. She told me. She said it's just like work nowadays. It's a drag to play it and it's too much hard work, she said. Playing this chord. She plays a lot of wrong chords also. Like when George plays Pagano Street Blues, she just leaves out two chords in it. It sounds very funny. George don't like it either because he's kind of blowing in her ear and trying to make it…
But at that other place they had Sim Zimmerman on piano, Dave Oxley, Jack Willis and Williamson.
